qualification: Unmerged upstream PR #158 (Asahi 7.2.11 rebase, head bd526b3c) plus unmerged PR #157 as one local patch, pinned as a new build-only candidate. Replaces the wip2 pin (merged #139 source, 7.2.10), which stays on disk and booted as the owner's trial. Source and patch applicability are checked here; native build success, the 64-fix semantic parity (not re-run for 7.2.11), and J314S boot/dock/power/recovery acceptance are NOT established. Preserve shared-DTB fallback compatibility and review upstream M1-family Touch ID regression before hardware use.
